inputs.text: Owner requests automatic stable updates enabled on their local installation and enabled by default on future installs. Preserve explicit disable and existing saved preferences. Keep the established 24-hour CLI startup interval, verified downloads, offline fallback and MCP startup exception unchanged. Coordinate with the separately running v0.8.0 publication and do not amend its frozen tag.

At v0.8.0 revision 5f30e565d29c56904d333bd665fbfc72f3bb56e8 the archive installer configure_delivery and launcher default_config default auto_update false. The GitHub bootstrap already explicitly enables automatic updates on fresh installs and supports --no-auto-update. Existing delivery preference is preserved by archive install unless explicitly overridden. Change archive and missing-config defaults to true, test fresh installs plus explicit and persisted opt-outs, and enable owner config only after release agent completes verified stable installation.
